name: Peet's Coffee Plain Warm Oatmeal with Brown Sugar (Nut Packet Discarded)
whyItWorks: Rolled whole oats steeped in hot water. Steaming softens the oats into easily absorbed soluble fiber. Discarding the companion dried fruit and nut pack keeps it free of stricture hazards.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Warm Oatmeal plain with hot water.' Use the brown sugar packet; discard the walnut and dried cranberry packet.
